title: m5stack/M5Cardputer-UserDemo #48: rich-click/bitarray failure comes from an ESP-IDF v6.1 Python env, not from the repo

execution.environment: macOS arm64; Python 3.13.15 (uv); local ESP-IDF checkout tag v6.1 (6.1.0); no Cardputer hardware used

evidence_class: host-level test plus code-level verification; no hardware or virtual-device runtime

checks.name: issue_open_no_prior_reply
checks.evidence: state=OPEN, comments=0, author_association=NONE, no related PR; evidence/issue-48.json

checks.name: repo_declares_idf_4_4_6
checks.evidence: README.md:14 'ESP-IDF v4.4.6'; dependencies.lock:18 'version: 4.4.6'; flash.sh IDF_PATH=$HOME/esp/esp-idf-v4.4.6; evidence/repo-toolchain.txt

checks.name: repo_has_no_install_script_or_python_requirements
checks.evidence: 688 tracked files, no install.sh, no build requirements file; grep 'rich-click|bitarray' -> none; evidence/repo-toolchain.txt

checks.name: rich_click_1_9_0_belongs_to_idf_6_1
checks.evidence: official espidf.constraints.v6.1.txt line 8 'rich-click~=1.9.0'; absent from ESP-IDF v4.4.6 requirements.txt (only click>=7.0); evidence/idf-constraints.txt

checks.name: checker_reports_stale_requirement_name
checks.evidence: tools/check_python_dependencies.py:135 sets req, :176 prints it inside the dependency-tree except; requirement set order varies per process; evidence/checker-source.txt

checks.name: host_repro_rich_click_version_error
checks.evidence: realistic IDF v6.1 venv passes the checker, then rich-click==1.8.9 downgrade yields 'Requirement rich-click~=1.9.0 was not met. Installed version: 1.8.9'; evidence/host-repro-idf61-env.txt

checks.name: host_repro_bitarray_metadata_error
checks.evidence: removing only bitarray's dist-info reproduces 'No package metadata was found for bitarray'; evidence/host-repro-bitarray.txt

checks.name: host_repro_name_randomization
checks.evidence: across 18 runs the printed prefix was packaging, bitstring or rich-click~=1.9.0 while the bitarray text stayed constant; one run matches the issue text verbatim; evidence/host-repro-bitarray.txt

checks.name: build_idf_4_4_6
checks.evidence: ESP-IDF 4.4.6 toolchain not installed; repo buildability not established by this record

checks.name: build_idf_6_1
checks.evidence: 6.1 is not the declared toolchain; post-Python errors would be a separate issue

checks.name: inspect_reporter_environment
checks.evidence: no Diagnostic information block, idf.py --version or python -V from the reporter; attribution is inferred from constraints and checker source

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: failure occurs before any firmware exists

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: no firmware/image/serial/framebuffer exists at this stage; Device Service and esp-emulator cannot exercise a host Python env check

limitations: No ESP-IDF v4.4.6 build was executed, so 'the repo builds' is not proven.
The reporter's exact environment was not inspected; the conclusion is that the checker is using ESP-IDF v6.1 constraints, inferred from the unique rich-click~=1.9.0 pin.
Why install.sh did not update the checked environment is not directly observed; the reply requests the checker's Diagnostic information block.
No hardware or virtual-device validation applies to a host Python dependency check.
